snippet.title: Arctic Station Six – Announcement Trailer | Programming Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5387040/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/4wmGBbXAbY

Arctic Station Six is an assembly programming puzzle game. Program an automatic weather station on the Arctic ice, then watch it survive a 160-day winter on your code alone.

Nobody lives at Station Six. You have the summer to program it, then the last plane leaves and the station is on its own. If there's a mistake in your code, it runs the mistake all winter.

- Write assembly for the station's loggers, controllers and drone
- Wire parts together, keep tables in memory, control complex machinery
- Survive gales, snow drifts and the polar night on the charge you can store or make
- Step, set breakpoints, rewind any moment of the winter
- Optimize for cycles, lines and charge, and compare with your friends and the world
#indiegame #programminggame #puzzlegame
